svg.aria-label: Sketch after a photograph on NBC News: a flooded residential street in Point Pleasant, New Jersey, on Saturday, an SUV stopped in the middle of the road with grey water up to its hood, two-story shore houses with gabled roofs and porches on both sides, a parking sign on a pole in the left foreground, utility poles and sagging wires down the street and an overcast sky. No people are in the scene.
